# Setup
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")

library(Biostrings)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

khdir <- here("species/crob/genome/refseq_KH")
genomedir <- here("species/crob/genome/KY21")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

genes_ky <- read_tsv(here(genomedir, "results/genes/gene-display-names.tsv"))
genes_kh <- read_tsv(here(khdir,     "results/genes/gene-display-names.tsv"))

prot_ky <- readAAStringSet(here(genomedir, "results/fasta/KY21_proteins_met_with-mito.fasta.gz"))
prot_kh <- readAAStringSet(here(khdir, "data/refseq/GCF_000224145.3_KH_protein.faa.gz"))

pids_ky <- read_tsv(here(genomedir, "results/genes/gid-pid_mapping.tsv"))
pids_kh <- read_tsv(here(khdir, "results/genes/gid-pid_mapping.tsv"))
```


```{r}
accepted_categories <- c("transcription factor",
                         "digestive",
                         "marker")

accepted_groups <- c("brush border membrane enzyme",
                     "transporter",
                     "pinocytosis",
                     "phagocytosis",
                     "endocytosis",
                     "digestive enzyme",
                     "lumen protection",
                     "gut",
                     "parahox",
                     "hox",
                     "exocrine")

add_entries <- function(
    category = NA_character_,
    group = NA_character_,
    name_free = NA_character_, 
    gene_id = NA_character_, 
    symbol_hsap = NA_character_, 
    symbol_mmus = NA_character_, 
    gene_id_kh = NA_character_, 
    source = NA_character_, 
    notes = NA_character_
) {
  
  if (!all(is.na(category))) {
    stopifnot(all(category %in% accepted_categories))
  }
  
  if (!all(is.na(group))) {
    stopifnot(all(group %in% accepted_groups))
  }
  
  new_entries <- tibble(
    category = category,
    group = group,
    name_free = name_free,
    gene_id = gene_id,
    symbol_hsap = symbol_hsap,
    symbol_mmus = symbol_mmus,
    gene_id_kh = gene_id_kh,
    source = source,
    notes = notes
  )

  bind_rows(cand, new_entries)
}
```


```{r}
# receptacle for data

cand <- tibble(
  category = vector("character"),
  group = vector("character"),
  name_free = vector("character"),
  gene_id     = vector("character"),
  symbol_hsap = vector("character"),
  symbol_mmus = vector("character"),
  gene_id_kh  = vector("character"),
  source      = vector("character"),
  notes       = vector("character")
)
```


# Sources

- Iguchi 2023a: Iguchi, R., Nakayama, S., Sasakura, Y., Sekiguchi, T., & Ogasawara, M. (2023). Repetitive and zonal expression profiles of absorption-related genes in the gastrointestinal tract of ascidian Ciona intestinalis type A. *Cell and Tissue Research*. https://doi.org/10.1007/s00441-023-03828-9
- Iguchi 2023b: Iguchi, R., Usui, K., Nakayama, S., Sasakura, Y., Sekiguchi, T., & Ogasawara, M. (2023). Multi-regional expression of pancreas-related digestive enzyme genes in the intestinal chamber of the ascidian Ciona intestinalis type A. *Cell and Tissue Research*, 394(3), 423–430. https://doi.org/10.1007/s00441-023-03839-6

# Transcription factors

```{r}
cand <- add_entries(category = "transcription factor",
                    group = "gut",
                    name_free = "Ptf1a",
                    gene_id = "KY21.Chr3.511",
                    source = "Iguchi 2023b")

cand <- add_entries(category = "marker",
                    group = "exocrine",
                    name_free = "Ptf1a",
                    gene_id = "KY21.Chr3.511",
                    source = "Iguchi 2023b")

cand <- add_entries(category = "transcription factor",
                    group = "gut",
                    name_free = "Nr5a2",
                    gene_id = c("KY21.Chr6.232"),
                    source = "Iguchi 2023b")
```

## ParaHox genes

```{r}
cand <- add_entries(category = "transcription factor",
                    group = c("gut", "parahox"),
                    name_free = "Pdx",
                    gene_id = c("KY21.Chr14.616"),
                    source = "Iguchi 2023b")

cand <- add_entries(category = "transcription factor",
                    group = c("gut", "parahox"),
                    name_free = "Cdx",
                    gene_id = c("KY21.Chr14.584"),
                    source = "Iguchi 2023b")

cand <- add_entries(category = "transcription factor",
                    group = "parahox",
                    name_free = "Gsx",
                    gene_id = genes_ky$gene_id[which(genes_ky$symbol == "[g] Gsx")])
```

# Write file

```{r}
cand <- left_join(cand, select(genes_ky, -display_name), by = "gene_id")

write_tsv(cand, here(genomedir, "results/genes/candidate-genes.tsv"))
```


```{r}
knitr::knit_exit()
```


## Hox genes

```{r}
genes_ky %>% 
  filter(str_detect(symbol, regex("hox", TRUE)))
```

           str_detect(display_name, regex("fatty acid binding", TRUE)))
